시편-52-1.title: 시편 52장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-52-1.exegesis: 19. God reconciled, material sacrifices will be acceptable ( Psa 4:5 ; compare Is 1:11-17 ).
시편-52-1.theologicalNote: 19. God reconciled, material sacrifices will be acceptable ( Psa 4:5 ; compare Is 1:11-17 ).

시편-52-2.title: 시편 52장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-52-2.exegesis: PSALM 52 Psa 52:1-9 . Compare 1Sa 21:1-10; 22 :1-10, for the history of the title. Psa 52:1 gives the theme; the boast of the wicked over the righteous is vain, for God constantly cares for His people. This is expanded by describing the malice and deceit, and then the ruin, of the wicked, and the happy state of the pious. 1. mighty man-- literally, "hero." Doeg may be thus addressed, ironically, in respect of his might in slander.

시편-52-8.title: 시편 52장 8절 역사문법적 주해
